meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按你的要求把一个 NanoClaw 代理组切到本机 Ollama:改运行配置和模型名,让该组后续消息不再发往 Anthropic API,而由 Ollama 回复。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 NanoClaw 代理组在本地跑、省 API 费用,或试用开源权重模型时触发;前提是 Ollama 已运行并拉好模型、对应代理组已存在。

say.text: 把 demo 这个代理组切到 Ollama 的 gemma4。
say.note: 会先问明组名和模型,然后改配置并重启。

say.text: 让 test 这个代理组改用 Ollama 的 qwen3-coder。
say.note: 会把模型名写进该组共享设置文件。

say.text: 给 demo 代理组接 Ollama,并屏蔽 Anthropic API。
say.note: 会把 Anthropic 域名加入屏蔽列表并重启。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can point a NanoClaw agent group at a local Ollama instance as requested: it changes the runtime environment variables and the model name, so future messages for that group go to Ollama instead of the Anthropic API.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user wants a NanoClaw agent group to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Prerequisites: Ollama is running with a pulled model and the agent group already exists.

say_en.text: Switch the demo agent group to Ollama's gemma4.
say_en.note: It will confirm the group/model, update config, and restart.

say_en.text: Point the test agent group at Ollama's qwen3-coder.
say_en.note: Will write the model into the shared settings file.

say_en.text: Connect demo agent group to Ollama and block api.anthropic.com.
say_en.note: Adds the host to the blocked list and restarts.
